SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COMPANY, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_CNT, DS_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND COMPANY = 'BNGG' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 100
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PO_NUMBER, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, '1' AS PO_COUNT, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'R' END AS CONFIRM_FLAG, A.KEY_01 AS CONFIRM_USERID, A.KEY_02 AS CONFIRM_USERNAME, A.KEY_03 AS CONFIRM_TIME, A.KEY_10 AS REMARK, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CODE, B.DESCRIPTION AS ITEM_NAME, B.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE, A.DS_DATE AS CD_DATE, A.DS_QTY AS CD_QTY, A.PLANT AS ORG_CODE, A.COMPANY ||'^'|| A.LEGACY_PO_NO ||'^'|| A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ ||'^'|| A.LEGACY_PO_CNT ||'^'|| A.DS_SEQ AS KEP_KEY FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND A , ICOMPODT B WHERE A.COMPANY = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND A.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE A.COMPANY = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND A.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_DS_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE A.COMPANY = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND A.LEGACY_PO_CNT = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_CNT$' AND A.DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
